subject: Fix incorrect memory overhead calculation for watched keys (#3359)
reason: The change is a one-line correctness fix to a memory-accounting constant in multiStateMemOverhead() (sizeof(watchedKey) instead of sizeof(list)), altering the per-watched-key client-memory estimate by 8 bytes per key. It flows only into getClientMemoryUsage(), i.e. the tot-mem field of CLIENT INFO/CLIENT LIST, the mem_clients_normal/clients.normal figures in INFO memory and MEMORY STATS, and the maxmemory-clients eviction budget.
